name: underscore-extensionpack
description: Syntax highlighting, hover documentation, snippets, and compiler-backed live diagnostics for Underscore and UFG files.

underscore.compilerPath.description: Path to the built Underscore compiler executable. Required for compiler-backed live diagnostics when the compiler cannot be discovered inside the workspace.

underscore.standardLibraryPath.description: Directory containing standard-library modules such as io._ and math._. Passed to the compiler through UNDERSCORE_STDLIB.

underscore.enableLiveDiagnostics.description: Run the Underscore compiler in check-only mode while editing and report diagnostics in the Problems panel.

underscore.enableInlineErrorLens.description: Show a compact inline message after lines with compiler errors or warnings.

underscore.diagnosticDelayMs.description: Debounce delay before checking a document after an edit, in milliseconds.
